goal: Preserve the accepted Lucas timbre and fluidity exactly, soften dryness only slightly, and carry that same natural movement into French.

reference_use.uploaded_lucas_clips: primary timbre, rhythm and presence reference
reference_use.lucas_voice_bank_v1: accepted timbre and fluidity base from user-provided Lucas speech moments
reference_use.lucas_voice_bank_v3_subtle_soft: preferred tonal direction: only 10-15 percent softer than the accepted base, with no pitch, speed or phrase-timing change
reference_use.validated_v10a: legacy visio anchor only; do not let it override the newer accepted base

accepted_characteristics.register: naturally low male voice, not artificially deep
accepted_characteristics.tone: same accepted masculine vocal color, only slightly warmer and rounder
accepted_characteristics.delivery: same accepted connected, fluid, conversational movement
accepted_characteristics.variation: preserve natural pitch and energy movement exactly; never flatten it
accepted_characteristics.diction: casual spoken French, linked words, relaxed consonants, no textbook diction
accepted_characteristics.softening_limit: subtle only; approximately 10-15 percent perceptual softening, never enough to blur identity or articulation

next_route.principle: preserve accepted timbre and flow, improve only language and slight warmth
next_route.source_requirement: Use a natural continuous French performance as the source whenever a new line is created.
next_route.processing: Only subtle tonal softening and normalization before candidate review; do not alter pitch, tempo, phrase timing or prosodic contour.
next_route.french_target: Natural conversational metropolitan French with linked phrasing, contractions, relaxed consonants, soft endings and irregular human timing while preserving the accepted Lucas vocal movement.
forbidden: pitch shifting to make the voice deeper
replacing the accepted timbre base with a new voice identity

approval_rule: One short French candidate must preserve the accepted timbre and fluidity before any dialogue pack expansion or live visio change.
